current_evidence: The workbook page and the council's indexed 'Local validation list' page (.../apply-for-planning-permission/local-validation-list/) show the same list stating 'This list was published on 10 April 2025', with a matrix image dated 10 April 2025 and a BNG form updated Aug 2026; no newer list was found.

issues.detail: List date is recorded as 2025-04-01 even though the date basis Grokbot itself quotes is 10 April 2025.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'This list was published on 10 April 2025.'

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but several local requirements on the list apply to householder applications: Flood risk form (all householder and other minor extensions in Flood Zones 2 and 3); Parking layout plan (loss of parking space(s) or increase in bedrooms); Street scene (extensions that increase ridgeline height where there are immediately adjacent neighbours); Roof plan (dormer windows / complex roof forms); Heritage statement (affecting a conservation area, listed building or setting); Tree survey (trees in or next to the site); Biodiversity wildlife checklist.
issues.evidence: Flood risk form: 'required for all householders and other minor extensions in flood zones 2 and 3'; Parking layout plan: 'Required if there is a loss of parking space(s) or an increase in bedrooms.'

issues.detail: Grokbot does not capture many local requirements at all (it counts 15 items and has only one tab item, against about 25 local headings in the source). Missing: Air quality assessment (sensitive development close to significant pollutant sources, or development likely to significantly increase emissions, e.g. commercial kitchens, near Farnborough Airport); Noise impact assessment (residential; medical/educational/day nurseries; pubs/nightclubs; places of worship; sports facilities; noisy industrial; wind turbines; development next to major roads/rail/industrial noise sources); Street scene (infill properties including replacement dwellings; extensions raising the ridgeline); Tree plan (TPO / conservation area trees or trees within falling distance); Landscaping details; Employment and skills plan; Transport assessment; Planning statement; Specification of works; Biodiversity wildlife checklist (Hampshire checklist); Amended plans.
issues.evidence: Local requirements headings on the page: 'Air quality assessment', 'Noise impact assessment', 'Street scene', 'Tree plan', 'Landscaping details', 'Employment and skills plan', 'Transport assessment', 'Specification of works'.

issues.detail: Requirements tied to specific application types are missing, so those rows are wrong. Discharge of conditions and Variation of condition s73 are marked '(none)', but the list requires 'Details relevant to each condition' (enough detail for each condition being discharged; plans or documents showing the change for removal/variation). Under 'Evidence to support application' the list also asks for relevant, detailed evidence for Lawful development certificates, a detailed block plan for prior approval of a larger home extension, and a supporting statement for all other prior approvals. Grokbot's LDC row has only Roof plan, and its prior approval row has only FRA. 'Evidence of date of planting' for hedgerow removal is also omitted.
issues.evidence: Headings 'Details relevant to each condition' (approval of details reserved by a condition; removal / variation of a condition) and 'Evidence to support application' (lawful development certificates; prior approval: larger home extension; all other prior approval applications).

issues.detail: The only tab item is the trigger list for the 'Measured site survey' requirement, filed under 'Drawing / document standards' without the requirement's name. Measured site survey is a separate local requirement, not a drawing convention.
issues.evidence: 'Measured site survey' required for sites of irregular or complex shape, infill developments, applications covering a large area, and development involving a substantial change in ground levels.

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger excerpt runs on into the Heritage statement trigger ('...1 hectare or more Heritage statement Required for: ... Applications for Listed Building Consent'). It also omits the separate householder Flood risk form trigger for Flood Zones 2 and 3.
issues.evidence: Source treats 'Flood risk form / assessment' and 'Heritage statement' as separate headings.

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment and Lighting Assessment are placed under Listed building consent only because the words 'Listed Building Consent' / 'listed buildings' appear in spilled-over heritage text and in the lighting impact description. The source does not tie either requirement to LBC. Putting FRA under 'Change of use - prior approval' is also a guess: the source says 'change of use in flood zones 2 and 3', meaning change-of-use applications.
issues.evidence: Lighting assessment item lists 'expected impact on neighbouring residential properties, roads, listed buildings, and conservation areas' as content, not as a trigger.

issues.detail: Heritage statement appears only under Listed building consent, although the source also requires it for planning applications (full or householder) that affect a conservation area, listed building or other heritage asset. Tree survey appears only under Works to trees, although its main trigger is 'to accompany a planning application'. Roof plan appears only under LDC, although it is also required for new properties and for dormers or complex roof forms.
issues.evidence: Heritage statement 'Required for: Planning applications affecting a conservation area or its setting; ... affecting a listed building ...; Applications for Listed Building Consent'.

issues.detail: The Works to trees row quotes the tree survey trigger for planning applications. The tree-works trigger is different: works to TPO trees on grounds of disease, fear of failure, subsidence or structural damage, supported by diagnostic or technical evidence.
issues.evidence: Tree survey sub-heading 'Application for tree works' (TPO trees: disease, fear of failure, subsidence or structural damage).

issues.detail: The Ventilation / Extraction excerpt starts mid-sentence ('where substantial ventilation...') and drops the uses that trigger it: new restaurants and cafés, pubs and drinking establishments, hot food takeaways, launderettes, mixed food and drink, and major retail/industrial/leisure with substantial equipment. It also omits that a statement saying no equipment is proposed is acceptable.
issues.evidence: Ventilation / extraction statement 'Required for: New restaurants and cafés; New pubs or drinking establishments; New hot food takeaways; New laundrettes ...'

issues.detail: 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' is not a listed requirement. The excerpt is a sentence from inside the Air quality assessment item about controlling construction emissions. The Air quality assessment itself, with its trigger, is not captured.
issues.evidence: Air quality assessment item: 'construction management plans, where deemed necessary, will be required...'

issues.detail: 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is not a local requirement. The excerpt comes from the national site location / block plan guidance (red line, blue line, Ordnance Survey licence number).
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'A blue line should be drawn around any other land owned by the applicant ... you must show the Ordnance Survey licence number on the plan.'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement row cites the statutory DMPO description of DAS content. DAS is listed under the page's national requirements, and the excerpt gives no local trigger.
issues.evidence: Page groups 'design and access statement' under National requirements.

issues.detail: 9 of the 11 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. BNG, Ecological survey, Parking layout plan, Ventilation, Affordable housing). The council publishes a requirements-by-application-type matrix (image dated 10 April 2025, plus an 'alternative version' page that Grokbot lists in docs_read), but the rows do not reflect it. Affordable housing, for example, also applies to outline applications. The matrix itself could not be read in this audit (image, and the alternative page URL was too long to fetch).
issues.evidence: matrix-for-local-validation-list-10-april-2025.jpg; 'Alternative version for the list of requirements for each type of planning application'.

summary: Grokbot's link works and is the current list (published 10 April 2025), but the date is off by nine days. The extraction is thin: about a dozen local requirements are missing (air quality, noise, street scene, tree plan, landscaping, employment and skills plan, condition and LDC/prior approval evidence), householder is wrongly shown as having no local requirements, and several rows are mis-triggered or put under the wrong application type.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
